text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(This flow...!? The race is turning 
completely in my favor—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If Lady Luck is on my side! Daaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Rulership!! Claiming the first crown 
is Rulership!

The primary objective was reconnaissance. 
Even so, Rulership brilliantly seized the 
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ruler-san.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Pisa. Hehe... Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahaha!! Even if it's luck, a win is 
a win! Yes, I am the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —...Or so I'd like to say.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"What brings me the greatest pleasure is 
not a victory by chance, but a calculated 
win. Furthermore—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This battle was merely the first round. 
It doesn't settle anything just yet."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is eyeing the next Japanese 
Derby, vigilantly biding their time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The Nippon Derby is indeed the final 
round for this generation. Who will reign 
supreme— I wonder who it'll be, Pisa?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, have we secured a foothold to build 
the Kingdom of Roses, then?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—33.0 seconds. Just a bit more—until I 
break through.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Still, after running against them, I felt 
it clearly... every single camp is 
undeniably a powerhouse.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"Flash-senpai, at this rate, the Japan 
Derby will likely turn into a fierce 
battle the likes of which history has 
rarely seen."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it will be a battle where a delay of 
even 0.01 seconds could prove fatal.

Everyone was already looking ahead to the 
next one. No—

Even before the race, everyone might have 
already been looking toward what comes 
next. Even so—
choice_data_list:
This year... the field is insanely 
stacked...

text_block_list.text:
The level of the other runners besides the 
favorites is remarkably high too. Years 
with a Classic Triple Crown this heated 
don't come around very often.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, I can't wait! On top of today's top 
runners, if new Umamusume join in too—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! With such a star-studded lineup, 
this year's Japan Derby will undoubtedly—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: It's the greatest Derby in history!
That night—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today's race made it crystal 
clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just focusing on the start and setting the 
pace nicely isn't enough to win the Japan 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of Umamusume who excel at 
the gates. Even if I were to cover that 
area...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My start will only ever be "average." I 
can't close the gap, and in the end, it 
won't be enough. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We need a strategy. Something outside of 
the start that will overwhelmingly surpass 
the other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time for a session, Trainer. 
We're going to come up with a 
game-changing strategy no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A winning move that will decide 
everything. Our "Japanese Derby" has 
already begun.

The two of us racked our brains. Even as 
the moon set and the sun rose, our 
strategy meeting continued endlessly.
